name: Overload
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/2 levels (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target’s magical defenses to malfunction. You make a targeted dispel attempt per the spell dispel magic at the highest CL of qualifying effects. On a success the spell- or magic-item-granted resistances and immunities to damage, AC bonuses, and saving throw bonuses are suppressed for the duration of this spell.
